name: Aqua
source:
A strange young girl encountered in Plen Arc, she is in actuality, one of God's four mediums.
By all appearances, she is merely a child, but in reality is older than ALES and talks as if she were an adult.
She takes an interest in ALES and decides to help him under certain conditions. 

[Taken from Hirameki International]
